_about: Copy per arm: the docker inputs of SVShell/GATKSVPipelineSingleSample mapped to the exact image each one should run. Build the images with docker/gatk-sv-build.sh; the tag it prints is <branch>-<sha6>.
_why_explicit: These are literals on purpose. Left as workspace-attribute references, a rerun silently inherits whatever the attribute pointed at, and you measure the old code while believing you measured the new one.
_gatk_note: Do NOT add gatk_docker for sv-shell arms: /opt/gatk.jar inside an sv-shell image is built at that Dockerfile's own GATK pin, which is the thing worth checking (checks/wdl_gate.sh and checks/image-check/ tell you whether the pin is stale).
